title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Alcazar
description: Alcazar (fortified palace), a specialization of HistoricalOrCulturalResource (estur:HistoricalOrCulturalResource, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology) — one of 43 such subclasses in the full ontology (others include Museum, Castle, Cathedral, Monastery, etc.), of which this candidate only covers the three demonstrated with real example data. NOTE: the source repository's example data uses the misspellings 'Amphiteatre' and 'Acueduct'; the authoritative ontology spells these 'Amphitheatre' and 'Aqueduct', which are used here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Alcazar'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this resource (estur:name).

hasLocation.description: Relationship. The Location of this resource (estur:hasLocation).

hasContactPoint.description: Relationship. The ContactPoint of this resource, if any (estur:hasContactPoint).

hasDescription.description: Relationship. The Description of this resource (estur:hasDescription).

hasBookingChannel.description: Relationship. The BookingChannel(s) through which a visit to this resource can be booked, if applicable (estur:hasBookingChannel). Formally consistent here: HistoricalOrCulturalResource is a direct subclass of TourismResource, which is in hasBookingChannel's declared domain.

hasMultimedia.description: Relationship. Multimedia resources associated with this resource (estur:hasMultimedia).

hasOpeningHours.description: Relationship. The opening hours of this resource (estur:hasOpeningHours).

offersAdditionalHistoricalAndCulturalRes.description: Relationship. Additional services offered at this resource, from the HistoricalAndCulturalResourceService controlled vocabulary (estur:offersAdditionalHistoricalAndCulturalResourceService).
